body: I'm hesitant at first, but curiosity clouds my judgment. The low hum grows louder as I stand still, trying not to disturb any potential occupants without knowing them. My heart races slightly at the thought of being caught in an unexpected situation. With a deep breath, I step forward, my hands reaching out tentatively towards the source of the sound. As my fingers brush against the wood beneath me, a faint echo reverberates through the room, amplifying the initial sensation of something unseen lurking just below the surface.
